title: Native mailbox home RPC capacity refusals block coordination sends and identical retries
outcome: Native mailbox home RPC saturation has a diagnosed bounded recovery path: an unchanged operation can complete once capacity is available, with one durable delivery and accurate receipt/unknown-outcome reporting.
acceptance: Diagnose the reported 429 native_mailbox_home_rpc_limit_reached from evidence, identifying which capacity is exhausted and whether requests release it correctly; distinguish capacity rejection from federation-link loss and uncertain append outcomes.

Fix the confirmed defect without bypassing provider refusals, minting a replacement message identity, changing routes to replay unresolved mail, or introducing unbounded work; an unchanged operation can recover through the supported route after capacity is available.
Behavior tests cover capacity saturation and release, identical-key retry with at most one durable append, and lost-response recovery preserving the original operation binding.
